entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Sales' or 'Support' to be routed to the correct department.
Connecting you to a support agent now.
Thank you for calling VeloFit support. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi... um, I think I need to return something? I bought some mountain bike shoes a while ago.
I can certainly look into that for you. To start, could I get your order number or the email address associated with your VeloFit account?
Yes, it's... sam.jones@email.com. The order was from about a month ago.

Thank you, Sam. I see your order for the VeloFit XT-Pro cycling shoes, delivered 30 days ago. To understand the situation better, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault with the shoes or more of a preference issue?

I... I really don't know. I put the cleats on and rode with them a few times, but they just hurt my feet so much. I got these terrible blisters. The website made them sound so perfect. I'm just really confused. Can't you just help me?

I'm very sorry to hear they caused you blisters; that definitely sounds unpleasant. It sounds like it's a matter of fit and comfort rather than a manufacturing defect. Let me just pull up our return policy to check on your options for a refund.
Okay... I just hope it's not too late. I feel a bit helpless here.
Not at all. I've just checked our policy for standard items. Since you received the shoes just 30 days ago, you are well within our 90-day return window. I can absolutely approve this return for you.
Oh, really? That's such a relief! Thank you so much. I was so worried I was stuck with them.

Of course. We want to make sure you're happy with your gear. I'm sending a pre-paid return label to your email now. Just pack the shoes in a box, attach the label, and you can drop them off at any post office. Your refund will be processed once we receive the item.
That's wonderful. Thank you for making it so easy.
You're very welcome, Sam. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
